title: Hard truths I wish I knew *at 20*

label: TRUTH 1
head: Comfort turns into a cage
sub: Same job, same couch, same weekend. Safe until you're 35 and stuck.

label: TRUTH 2
head: Stop pitching your plan to quitters
sub: They will talk you out of it in 5 minutes. Show them in a year.

label: TRUTH 3
head: Some friends are for one season
sub: Not everyone who partied with you at 20 is coming to 30.

label: TRUTH 4
head: Freedom beats impressing people
sub: Auto-save 20% on payday. The watch can wait.

label: TRUTH 5
head: Your health is part of your success
sub: A raise means nothing if you're too tired to enjoy it.

head: Start *before you're ready*
sub: Confidence shows up after the first rep, not before.
